reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: 13.1 extends the subscription licence to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf; 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software/embedded Vendor Technology with contractor support rights; 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation/suspension to material uncured breach after notice and cure opportunity.
No at-will revocability language ('revocable', Vendor discretion) is present, so the walk-away trigger is absent and the preferred position is met on all material terms.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs; deterministic checks for affiliate coverage and absence of at-will revocation both pass.
'Non-exclusive' and the standard 13.4 use restrictions do not defeat the rule, which targets affiliate/contractor coverage, revocability, and successor transfer.
